$comment: The art bible. Every sprite in the game is one row here. Shared style + framing live in tools/genart.py so this file stays about CONTENT. Five floors, each with a palette identity, three enemies, four animatable props, and a boss. Every prop has a matching golem form — animating the room is the core verb, so the golem roster is first-class content, not a variant.

assets.prompt: A SPELL ALTAR: a waist-high stone pedestal carved with arcane runes, a single open spellbook floating and rotating above it wreathed in violet light, loose glowing pages drifting upward. Three thin candles melted down its sides. Ancient, holy, inviting.

A SPENT SPELL ALTAR: a waist-high stone pedestal carved with arcane runes, now EMPTY — no book, nothing floating above it. The runes are dark and dead, no glow at all. Three candles melted down to stubs, wicks snuffed and smoking faintly. A shallow dusty depression on top where a book used to rest, with a few torn scraps of parchment left behind. Cold, abandoned, used up.
A TREASURE CHEST: a squat iron-banded wooden chest, lid shut, heavy padlock, gold coins spilling from a crack in the corner, faint warm glow leaking from the seams.

AN OPENED TREASURE CHEST: a squat iron-banded wooden chest with its lid thrown wide open on its hinges, the interior EMPTY except for a few scattered loose coins and a torn scrap of velvet lining. The broken padlock hangs off the hasp. No glow, no treasure left. Plundered and abandoned.

A STAIRWELL DOWN: a dark stone archway in a dungeon wall with worn steps descending into blackness, a cold blue glow rising from below, iron rings set in the stone, deep shadow swallowing the bottom steps.

An INK WRETCH: a hunched gaunt humanoid made of living black ink, its body dripping and running downward in long streaks, no face except a wide smear of a mouth and two white pinprick eyes. Long dribbling arms ending in dagger-like ink claws. Torn scholar's robes soaked through and clinging. Cold teal highlights in the black.
assets.attack: its whole arm stretched and thinned into a long whipping lance of liquid ink driven forward, the body leaning after it, black ink flung off the arc in fat droplets

assets.prompt: A CANDLE MOTH: a large sinister moth the size of a dog, its furred body a stub of dripping white wax with a live flame burning at the top of its thorax, four ragged parchment-textured wings covered in eye-spot patterns that look like written runes, six thin black legs. Warm orange glow on the underside of the wings.
assets.attack: all four wings snapped wide and swept back, and the flame on its thorax roaring up into a tall blinding column that showers sparks down over the wings

assets.prompt: A PAGE WRAITH: a floating hoodless spectre whose entire body is a swirling vortex of torn manuscript pages held in a human silhouette, hollow dark void where a face should be with two cold violet reading-lamp eyes, long trailing sleeves of loose parchment fraying into nothing at the bottom. It has no legs, tapering to a ragged wisp.
assets.attack: its vortex of manuscript pages erupting outward in a spiral storm of torn paper, the empty parchment sleeves flung wide, the violet lamp-eyes blazing white

assets.prompt: A DUNGEON BOOKSHELF: a tall dark oak shelf crammed with leather-bound spellbooks at crooked angles, some volumes fallen and stacked flat, brass clasps and coloured ribbon bookmarks, water-stained lower shelf, cobwebs in the top corner.

A FLOOR CANDELABRA: a tall wrought-iron candle stand with five lit beeswax candles at different melted heights, thick wax drips frozen down the arms, warm orange flames, a small pool of hardened wax at the clawed iron base.

A WATER BARREL: a squat wooden barrel bound with rusted iron hoops, brimming with dark still water, the lid leaning against its side, damp stains and green algae on the lower staves, a slow drip at the seam.

A READING LECTERN: a carved wooden reading stand with a huge open illuminated manuscript resting on its slanted top, a guttering candle stub clamped to one side, an inkwell and quill, brass page-weight chains hanging down.

THE UNBOUND INDEX, a library boss: an enormous floating grimoire the size of a door, its covers spread wide like wings, hundreds of pages fanning out from the spine in a great peacock display. A single vast eye stares out of the open pages. Chains and brass clasps hang broken from its edges. Dozens of smaller books orbit it. Violet arcane light pours from between the pages.
assets.attack: its spread covers thrown forward like slamming wings and the fanned pages compressed into a blast, the single vast eye stretched wide and glaring, a lance of violet light pouring out from between the pages, the orbiting books flung outward

assets.prompt: A CLEAVER SKELETON: an animated skeleton in a filthy blood-stained butcher's apron, a rusted meat cleaver fused into the bone of each forearm instead of hands, ribcage strung with hanging hooks, jaw hanging open in a grin, one eye socket lit with a sickly yellow flame. Grease-stained bone.
assets.attack: both forearm cleavers hauled up over the skull and brought down together in a heavy two-handed chop, ribcage hooks swinging with the motion

assets.prompt: A GREASE IMP: a small squat fat demon with glistening translucent yellow-brown skin like rendered fat, wide toothy grin, tiny horns, a distended dripping belly, stubby arms, big splayed webbed feet leaving greasy prints. It cradles a ladle. Slick highlights all over its body.
assets.attack: swinging its ladle in a wide arc and flinging a sheet of boiling grease off it, belly wobbling, weight thrown onto one splayed webbed foot

assets.prompt: A BONE HOUND: a skeletal dog assembled from mismatched animal bones, elongated snapping skull with too many teeth, exposed ribcage with a dull red ember burning inside, spine of stacked vertebrae, four bony legs with clawed paws, tail a whip of linked bones. Lean and predatory.
assets.attack: caught mid-pounce with all four legs off the ground, body stretched flat out, the over-toothed skull jaws hinged wide open to bite, the ember in its ribcage flaring

assets.prompt: A COOKING CAULDRON: a huge black cast-iron cauldron on three squat legs over a bed of glowing embers, thick green-brown stew bubbling over the rim, a bone handle sticking out of the broth, soot streaks up the belly, steam curling off the surface.

A MEAT RACK: a tall iron frame hung with rusted S-hooks holding slabs of cured dark meat and a stripped ribcage, chains and pulleys at the top bar, a drip tray of congealed fat at the base, flies. Grim and utilitarian.

A BONE PILE: a heaped mound of assorted yellowed bones and cracked skulls, femurs and ribs jutting out at angles, one intact skull sitting on top, scraps of dried sinew, dust. Loosely pyramidal and unstable-looking.
AN ALE BARREL: a fat oak keg on its side in a low wooden cradle, brass tap driven into the end, a dark sticky puddle beneath the tap, iron hoops, a chalked tally scrawled on the side, dented staves.

THE MARROW CHEF, a kitchen boss: a colossally obese towering butcher, skin pale and waxy, head a boiled ox skull wearing a filthy tall chef's toque, four arms each gripping a different implement - a cleaver, a two-tined fork, a ladle, a bone saw. Blood-soaked apron stretched over an enormous gut. Rings of sausages and hooks hang from a belt of chains. Steam rising off its shoulders.
assets.attack: all four arms swung in at once from four directions - cleaver, fork, ladle and bone saw converging - the ox skull lowered, steam ripping off its shoulders

assets.prompt: A SPORE HULK: a massive lumbering humanoid of rotted wet wood and packed moss, an enormous pale bracket-fungus cap growing where its head should be with no face at all, thick bursting puffball sacs clustered on its shoulders and back leaking green spore dust, arms like mossy logs, fingers of woody roots.
assets.attack: every puffball sac on its shoulders and back bursting at once into a thick green spore cloud, both log arms driven straight down into the ground

assets.prompt: A THORN CREEPER: a low quadrupedal beast woven entirely from barbed bramble vines and dead leaves, long wicked thorns bristling along its spine, a snapping jaw of splintered wood, two small hateful red flower-blooms for eyes, whipping vine tail. Hollow between the vines so you can see through its body.
assets.attack: every thorn along its spine bristling erect and its vine tail whipped forward over its own head like a scorpion, the splintered wooden jaw snapping

assets.prompt: A MYCELIUM PRIEST: a tall gaunt robed figure, its robes rotted grey sackcloth threaded with glowing pale mycelium veins, head a tall pointed toadstool cap shading a hollow dark face with three small glowing green eyes, long thin arms raised in benediction, fingertips trailing hanging white fungal threads.
assets.attack: arms flung wide and the mycelium veins in its robes blazing white, the hanging fungal threads at its fingertips lashing out straight ahead like harpoons

assets.prompt: A FUNGUS CLUSTER: a dense clump of oversized mushrooms of different heights, fat speckled caps in sickly green and violet, gills glowing faintly underneath, smaller toadstools crowding the base, moss and rotting leaf litter around them.

A GNARLED ROOT: a huge twisted tree root bursting up through a broken flagstone floor, bark split and weeping dark sap, tendrils curling in the air, clumps of wet moss and small ferns growing in its crevices, cracked stone shards pushed aside at the base.

A MOSSY STATUE: a weathered stone statue of a robed hooded figure with its face eroded smooth and featureless, one arm broken off at the elbow, thick green moss and pale lichen swallowing its lower half, ivy wrapped around the plinth, deep cracks up the torso.

A CRACKED PLANTER: a big terracotta urn split down one side, dark wet soil spilling out of the crack, a single sickly luminous flower with drooping violet petals growing from it, dead stems, tangled roots reaching out of the break.

MOTHER BLOOM, a fungal boss: an enormous swollen fungal queen, a vast bulbous sac-body of translucent pale flesh with dark spores swirling visibly inside it, crowned by a huge ring of luminous violet mushroom caps like a halo. A small withered humanoid torso and thin grasping arms emerge from the top of the sac. Thick root-tentacles anchor her to the ground and spread outward. Clouds of glowing spores drift around her.
assets.attack: the bulbous sac violently contracted to squeeze a dense spore cloud out of itself, the thick root-tentacles reared up off the floor, the small withered arms clawing forward

assets.prompt: A SLAG GOLEM: a broad humanoid of cooled black volcanic slag with molten orange lava glowing in every crack and seam of its body, no head - just a glowing furnace-hole in its chest, heavy asymmetric fists of fused metal and stone, thick stumpy legs, dripping embers falling from its knuckles, heat shimmer around its shoulders.
assets.attack: arched backward so the furnace-hole in its chest gapes open and vents a white-hot jet straight out, lava running brighter in every crack, embers streaming from its fists

assets.prompt: A BELLOWS FIEND: a hunched brass automaton whose torso is a great leather-and-brass accordion bellows mid-wheeze, a riveted iron mask face with a single glowing yellow lens eye and a pipe-nozzle mouth venting steam, thin articulated copper-tube arms, bird-like clawed metal feet, pressure gauge on its shoulder in the red.
assets.attack: its accordion bellows torso violently crushed flat, blasting a jet of fire and steam out of the pipe-nozzle mouth, the shoulder pressure gauge slammed past the red

assets.prompt: A CINDER WASP: a large mechanical wasp with a segmented red-hot glowing iron abdomen, two pairs of blurred brass wire-mesh wings, a long white-hot needle stinger, faceted furnace-orange compound eyes, sharp black mandibles, six barbed metal legs tucked under. Trailing sparks.
assets.attack: abdomen curled hard under and forward to drive the white-hot needle stinger out ahead of it, wings blurred into a smear, all six barbed legs thrown out to grip

assets.prompt: A FORGE ANVIL: a heavy black iron anvil on a scarred wooden stump, a glowing orange half-forged sword blade lying across its face, a hammer and tongs leaning against the stump, scattered slag and quench bucket, hot sparks on the ground.

A GEAR STACK: a leaning tower of enormous brass and iron cogwheels of different sizes stacked on an axle, teeth chipped and worn, thick black grease in the gaps, one gear still slowly turning, bolts and washers scattered at the base.

AN OIL DRUM: a dented riveted iron drum with a screw cap open at the top, thick black oil welling over the lip and running down the side into a slick puddle, rust blooms and a faded hazard stencil, a hand pump clamped to the rim.

A CHAIN HOIST: a heavy iron floor crane with a thick chain and a huge rusted hook hanging from its arm, a counterweight block, a hand crank with a ratchet, coiled slack chain heaped on the base plate, grease and rust.

THE OVERSEER ENGINE, a foundry boss: a towering brass and iron machine-god, a vast riveted boiler body with a roaring furnace door for a mouth spilling white-hot light, a crown of belching smokestacks, four long piston-driven arms ending in industrial claws and a glowing crucible, cracked pressure dials and a single enormous searchlight eye. Chains and cooling pipes wrap its frame. Standing on caterpillar treads.
assets.attack: its furnace door mouth thrown wide spilling white-hot light, all four piston arms punched out to full extension, every smokestack belching, the searchlight eye at glare

assets.prompt: A VOID ACOLYTE: a slender robed figure in deep midnight-blue vestments trimmed with gold constellation embroidery, no head at all - instead a slowly rotating sphere of starless black void hovering above the collar with a single ring of gold orbiting it, long sleeves, gloved hands cupping a tiny bright star. Hem of the robe frays into drifting stardust.
assets.attack: its cupped gloved hands flung open to release the tiny star, which flares blinding white, the void sphere where a head should be spinning fast enough to blur its gold ring

assets.prompt: A STAR HUSK: the hollow cracked shell of a humanoid statue made of pale grey moonstone, its chest and skull split wide open with brilliant white starlight blazing out of the hollow interior, cracks across the whole body leaking light, blank eyeless face, one arm ending in a shattered stump, weightless stone shards floating in orbit around the breaks.
assets.attack: the cracks across its whole body wrenched open so the shell comes apart, a single hard beam of white starlight firing forward out of the split in its chest and flooding the frame, every floating stone shard blown outward away from the body

assets.prompt: A MIRROR SENTINEL: an armoured guardian whose body is made of angular polished mirror shards held together by thin gold filigree, its face a perfectly flat oval mirror reflecting nothing, tall geometric shoulder plates, a gold circlet, hands of faceted glass blades. Its reflections show fragments of stars instead of the room.
assets.attack: its two faceted glass blade-hands scissored across each other in a cutting sweep, the flat mirror face tilted to throw a blinding starburst reflection at the viewer

assets.prompt: AN ORRERY: an ornate brass astronomical model on a tripod stand, concentric engraved rings on gimbals holding small planet spheres of coloured stone, a glowing golden sun sphere at the centre, tiny star-charts etched on the rings, one ring bent out of true.

A TELESCOPE: a long brass refracting telescope on a heavy wooden tripod aimed upward at a steep angle, engraved focus rings and a small finder scope, a rolled star chart and a compass on the tripod's shelf, tarnish and fingerprints on the tube.

A CRYSTAL CLUSTER: a cluster of tall sharp translucent blue-white crystals of varying heights growing out of a cracked stone base, inner light glowing along their axes, smaller shards scattered around the foot, faint refracted highlights on the facets.

A STAR FONT: a carved pale stone basin on a fluted pedestal filled with liquid starlight, pinpricks of light drifting up out of the water like slow sparks, gold constellation inlay around the rim, worn zodiac carvings on the pedestal, a thin overflow of light spilling down one side.

THE CARTOGRAPHER, a celestial boss: a colossal robed astronomer whose head is a great armillary sphere of gold rings with a burning blue star trapped at its centre, six arms - some holding brass dividers, a quill, an unrolled star map, others empty and open. Its midnight robe is a window onto a real starfield with constellations moving in it. A vast slowly rotating gold zodiac ring floats behind its shoulders like a halo.
assets.attack: the vast gold zodiac ring behind it spun up and blazing, all six arms spread wide with the star map snapped taut between two of them, the blue star in its armillary head flaring to white

assets.prompt: A STANDING PANE: a tall freestanding sheet of leaded garden glass in a wrought frame, stained in green and amber, a spidering crack across one corner. Ivy of clear glass climbs the frame.
A GLASS CLOCHE: a great bell-shaped garden cloche over a dead rosebush, condensation fogging the inside, a brass handle at its crown.
A GLASS TROUGH: a long planter of thick green glass full of still black water, glass reeds growing from it, algae fused into the walls.
A GARDEN LANTERN: a tall iron post lantern with four coloured glass faces, the flame inside long dead, moths of glass fused to its panes.

A GLASS BLOOM: a stalking flower-thing of fused coloured glass, a fanged tulip head on a whip-thin stem body, four petal-blades spread like a collar, root-tendrils of clear glass walking it forward. Light refracts through it in green and gold. Hairline fractures glow from within.
assets.attack: the tulip head snapped forward on the whipping stem and the four petal-blades flung wide, shards of coloured glass thrown off the fracture lines

assets.prompt: A SHARD HOUND: a lean four-legged predator assembled from broken window glass, its back a ridge of jagged panes, no eyes but a long muzzle of splintered edges. Lead came still runs through its flanks like veins. Moves in a scatter of light.
assets.attack: the splintered muzzle driven forward in a lunging bite, the ridge of panes along its back flared, cracked glass sloughing from its shoulders

assets.prompt: THE GLASS GARDENER: a tall stooped figure in a vitrified apron, hands fused into pruning shears of green glass, its head a bell jar containing a single still-living flower. Body is clouded milk glass, cracked and mended with gold.
assets.attack: both shear-hands scissored shut in a wide cross-cut, the bell-jar head tipped forward, the flower inside thrashing

assets.prompt: THE PRISM WARDEN, a glass gardens boss: a colossal seated figure of clear cut crystal, its body a single enormous faceted gem shaped like a kneeling gardener, splitting the light into hard rainbows across the room. Its head is a rough uncut geode with a violet glow deep inside. Vines of glass climb its arms.
assets.attack: the great faceted body leaned forward and both crystal arms swept in from the sides, hard rainbow light lancing out of every facet at once, glass vines whipping

assets.prompt: A HOARD PILE: a heaped drift of drowned gold coins, goblets and crowns, strung through with kelp and crusted with barnacles, seawater pooling at its base.
A CORAL COLUMN: a vault pillar entirely overtaken by brain and fan coral in dull pink and ochre, its carved stone base still visible, small fish bones caught in it.
A STRONGBOX: a squat iron-banded vault strongbox, its lock burst open, seawater and a few coins trickling from the seam. Rust runs down its faces.
A VAULT ANCHOR: an enormous ship's anchor driven through the vault floor, chain heaped around it, crusted with salt and small shells.

A DROWNED CLAIMANT: a bloated waterlogged corpse in a merchant's fine coat, pockets and hands overflowing with gold coins, barnacles across one shoulder, seawater pouring endlessly from its sleeves and mouth. Eyes are two coins.
assets.attack: both coin-laden hands flung forward in a grasping lunge, a gout of seawater vomited out with them, gold coins scattering off the arc

assets.prompt: A COFFER CRAB: a broad crab whose shell is an iron-bound treasure chest, the lid its carapace, gold spilling from the gap. Two enormous pincers of corroded brass. Small eyes on stalks peering over the lid.
assets.attack: both brass pincers slammed together in a scissoring snap, the chest-lid carapace thrown open, coins bursting out of the gap

assets.prompt: A BRINE EEL: a long ribbon of an eel coiling through the air as though still swimming, its skin translucent and full of swallowed coins and rings, a lantern-jawed head of needle teeth. Trails a wake of water.
assets.attack: the whole ribbon body recoiled and struck straight out like a spear, needle jaws spread wide, swallowed coins glinting through the translucent skin

assets.prompt: THE DROWNED FACTOR, a tidal vault boss: a vast bloated figure in the ruined finery of a treasury master, seated on a throne of heaped coin, its body swollen with seawater and split to show gold packed inside like organs. A great iron ledger chained to its wrist. Crowned with coral. Water pours constantly from beneath it.
assets.attack: the chained iron ledger swung round in a heavy arc and the split torso heaved forward, a wall of seawater and loose gold driven out ahead of it

assets.prompt: A LECTERN OF SKIN: a reading pulpit of pale stretched hide over bone, an open hymnal on it whose pages turn by themselves, a single candle guttering.
A HANGING BELL: a great cracked bronze bell hung from a blackened beam, its lip split, a long fraying bell-rope trailing to the floor.
AN ORGAN RANK: a bank of tarnished organ pipes of uneven height set into the wall, several bent, breathing faintly on their own.
A STANDING CENSER: a tall brass censer on a chain stand, still smoking, its pierced lid worked with open mouths, ash heaped at its foot.

A FLAYED CANTOR: a lean robed singer whose face has been opened into a second vertical mouth from brow to chin, both mouths held wide in song. Hands clasped in devotion. The choir robe is stitched to the flesh beneath.
assets.attack: both mouths stretched impossibly wide and the head thrown forward, a visible ring of sound punched out ahead of it, the clasped hands flung open

assets.prompt: A BELL-HEADED PENITENT: a stooped figure whose entire head is a heavy bronze handbell, clapper hanging where a throat would be, wearing a rope-belted habit. Deaf, and swinging its own head to hear.
assets.attack: the whole bronze bell head swung round on the neck like a hammer, the clapper snapping, a hard shock of sound thrown off the strike

assets.prompt: A HYMN OF WOUNDS: a hovering knot of loose hymn-sheet parchment and red ribbon wound around nothing, page edges rimmed with dried blood, small mouths opening across the pages as it drifts.
assets.attack: the knot of pages unfurled outward all at once into a wide flaring sheet, every small mouth on it opening together

assets.prompt: THE GREAT PRECENTOR, a choir boss: an immense conductor of flesh and bronze risen from the choir stalls, six long arms ending in bell-clappers, its head a vast open mouth ringed with smaller mouths in place of a face, robed in stitched hymn-sheets. Sound visibly distorts the air around it.
assets.attack: all six clapper-arms brought down together in a conductor's cut, the vast ringed mouth thrown open, the air itself buckling outward in rings

assets.prompt: A PETRIFIED COLUMN: a fluted stone column half-buried in drifted grey ash, its top sheared off, the ash piled waist-high around it.
A COLD KILN: a squat brick kiln with its iron door hanging open, the fire long dead, grey ash spilling out over the floor.
A SPLIT BELLOWS: a huge leather-and-iron forge bellows, the leather split and hanging, its nozzle choked with cold ash.
AN ASH CAIRN: a stacked cairn of black volcanic stones with grey ash drifted against one side, a single petrified hand reaching from beneath it.
A CINDER WALKER: a tall thin figure of packed grey ash holding its shape, cracks across its surface showing dull orange deep inside, no face. Ash sloughs from it constantly and reforms.
assets.attack: one long ash arm swung round in a wide flail that half-disintegrates on the arc, the orange cracks flaring bright through the body

assets.prompt: AN OBSIDIAN HOUND: a low heavy quadruped of black volcanic glass, its edges knapped sharp like a blade tool, a dull red glow at its joints. No eyes. Ash caked along its spine.
assets.attack: the whole knapped body driven forward in a low shoulder-charge, the glassy edges flared, chips of black glass thrown off

assets.prompt: AN ASH MOURNER: a kneeling petrified figure caught mid-grief, hands over its face, entirely grey — but risen and walking, cracked at every joint, ash pouring from the fractures.
assets.attack: the hands torn away from the petrified face to reveal a hollow of glowing ash, both arms flung outward, a cloud of grey ash driven forward

assets.prompt: THE LAST STOKER, an ashfall boss: an enormous figure of packed ash and cooled magma, hunched under the weight of a great iron shovel it still carries, its chest a dead firebox hanging open and full of cold grey ash. Orange light bleeds from the deepest cracks. Ash falls from it constantly like weather.
assets.attack: the great iron shovel swung two-handed in a low scooping arc, a wave of grey ash and cold cinders driven up and forward, the firebox chest flaring orange

assets.prompt: THE HOLLOW THRONE: a tall seat of carved obsidian, its back worked into a crown of thorns, absolutely empty, a thin cold light pooling in the seat.
A FALLEN BANNER: a huge royal banner of black cloth on a broken pole, its sigil unpicked and missing, the fabric heavy and still.
A ROYAL RELIQUARY: a black glass casket on a low bier, its lid slid aside, containing only a single thin gold circlet on velvet.
A COLD BRAZIER: a great standing brazier of black iron worked with crowns, its coals long dead and grey, tipped slightly on a broken leg.

A HOLLOW REGENT: a standing suit of black regalia — ermine collar, sash, heavy rings — with absolutely nothing inside it, the clothing holding a royal posture. Where the head should be, a floating thin gold circlet and a smear of starless dark.
assets.attack: the empty sleeves flung wide in a commanding gesture and the floating circlet driven forward, the starless dark inside the collar reaching out

assets.prompt: A VOID HERALD: a tall thin figure in a tabard of black cloth sewn with dead stars, carrying a long trumpet of obsidian, its face a smooth featureless oval of the same black glass.
assets.attack: the obsidian trumpet raised and blown, a cone of visible silence and dead starlight punched out of the bell

assets.prompt: AN OBSIDIAN KINGSGUARD: a heavy armoured figure in plate of black volcanic glass over nothing, a tower shield of the same glass, a straight sword. The visor is open and empty.
assets.attack: the tower shield driven forward in a shield-bash and the straight sword thrust past it, black glass plate grinding

assets.prompt: THE HOLLOW CROWN ITSELF, the final boss: a colossal ruined king of black glass and empty regalia, kneeling and vast, its enormous body a hollow shell of obsidian plate with nothing inside but a slow-turning void full of dead stars. A single thin gold circlet floats where its head should be, far too small for the body. Ermine and chain hang from its shoulders.
assets.attack: the colossal hollow body straightened and both empty gauntlets swept together overhead, the void inside the chest yawning open, dead stars pouring out of it

assets.$comment: Golem forms. Animating a prop is the core verb, so every prop has an authored risen form. Shared cues: violet arcane eyes, a hunched bipedal stance built from the object's own material, the object still recognisable in the silhouette.

assets.prompt: A BOOK GOLEM: a hulking humanoid built entirely out of old leather-bound spellbooks stacked and lashed together with brass clasps and torn ribbon bookmarks, loose pages fluttering at its shoulders, its head a single massive open tome with two glowing violet eyes burning in the pages, arms bundles of thick tomes ending in blocky fists, squat legs of stacked books. Menacing and arcane.

A CANDLE GOLEM: a spindly humanoid of twisted wrought iron and fused candle wax, five lit candles burning where its head should be casting warm light down its body, thick wax drips hardened over its iron ribs like melted armour, long thin arms of candle-stand arms with claw hooks, wax-pooled feet. Two glowing violet eyes in the wax of its chest.

A WATER GOLEM: a squat barrel-bodied creature, an open wooden barrel bound in rusted hoops for a torso brimming with dark water that sloshes over the rim, thick arms and stubby legs formed of flowing water held in shape by nothing, two glowing violet eyes floating in the water inside the barrel mouth, water streaming constantly down its staves.

A LECTERN GOLEM: a tall stooping creature built from a carved wooden reading stand, its slanted top opened wide like a snapping beak with an illuminated manuscript for a tongue, the lectern's post as a spine, splayed tripod legs of carved wood, two thin arms of brass page-chains with weight hooks, a guttering candle on one shoulder, glowing violet eyes above the beak.

A CAULDRON GOLEM: a big-bellied creature whose body is a black cast-iron cauldron on three squat legs, green-brown stew boiling and slopping over the rim, two thick arms of poured molten stew hardening into ladle-shaped fists, a bone handle jutting from its back, two glowing violet eyes in the broth, steam venting from under the rim.

A MEAT RACK GOLEM: a tall gangling creature of rusted iron frame bars and hanging chains, slabs of dark cured meat and a stripped ribcage strung on its S-hooks like a torso, long swinging chain-and-hook arms, thin bar legs, a pulley wheel for a head with two glowing violet eyes in the spokes. Dripping fat.

A BONE GOLEM: a lopsided humanoid assembled from a heap of mismatched yellowed bones jammed together at wrong angles, a cage of ribs for a chest, femurs for limbs, a cluster of three cracked skulls fused as its head with violet light burning in every eye socket, one oversized arm, bone shards flaking off as it moves.

AN ALE GOLEM: a fat rollicking creature with an oak keg for a body, brass tap in its belly gushing dark foaming ale, staves bulging apart under the pressure, arms and legs of frothing spilling ale held in rough limb shapes, a small keg head with two glowing violet eyes and a bung for a nose, sticky puddles at its feet.

A FUNGUS GOLEM: a lumpy squat creature grown from a clump of oversized mushrooms, a fat speckled green-and-violet cap as its head with glowing gills underneath, a body of packed pale mycelium and smaller toadstools sprouting from its shoulders, thick spongy arms, root-tangle feet, two glowing violet eyes under the cap brim, spore dust puffing off it.

A ROOT GOLEM: a long-limbed creature of twisted tree roots and split weeping bark, its torso a knotted burl, arms of writhing tendrils ending in grasping root-fingers, clumps of wet moss and small ferns growing in its crevices, a hollow knot of a face with two glowing violet eyes deep inside, cracked flagstone shards still clinging to its feet.

A STATUE GOLEM: a weathered stone statue of a hooded robed figure come to life, its eroded featureless face now split by a jagged crack with violet light blazing out, one arm broken off at the elbow, thick green moss and lichen hanging from its stone shoulders, deep cracks across the torso glowing violet from within, chunks of its own plinth clutched in its remaining hand.

A PLANTER GOLEM: a top-heavy creature with a split terracotta urn for a body, dark wet soil spilling from the crack like guts, a single huge luminous violet flower blooming where its head should be with two glowing violet eyes at its centre, thick braided root arms reaching out of the break, stubby clay legs, trailing vines.

AN ANVIL GOLEM: an enormously top-heavy creature with a black iron anvil for a torso and head fused as one, the anvil's horn jutting forward like a snout, a glowing orange half-forged blade embedded in its shoulder, thick short arms of hammer heads and tongs, tiny stubby legs of scarred wood stump, two glowing violet eyes on the anvil face, sparks showering off it.

A GEAR GOLEM: a humanoid assembled from enormous brass and iron cogwheels, a big gear as its chest still slowly turning, smaller gears as shoulder and hip joints, arms and legs of axles and toothed racks, a single large cogwheel for a head with two glowing violet eyes between the teeth, thick black grease weeping from its joints.

AN OIL GOLEM: a dented riveted iron drum for a body with its cap burst open, thick black oil surging up out of the top and welling over the sides, arms and legs of viscous dripping oil held in rough limb shape, a hand pump jutting from its shoulder like a weapon, two glowing violet eyes in the oil pouring from the drum's mouth, slick black puddles at its feet.

A HOIST GOLEM: a tall crane-like creature of heavy iron frame bars, a long articulated arm ending in a huge rusted hook swinging low, a counterweight block hanging as its other fist, a ratchet crank wheel for a head with two glowing violet eyes in the spokes, coiled chains draped over its shoulders, spindly braced legs, grease and rust.

AN ORRERY GOLEM: a floating creature of concentric engraved brass rings spinning on gimbals around a glowing golden sun-sphere core, small planet spheres of coloured stone orbiting as its hands, ring segments arranged into shoulders and a suggestion of a torso, no legs, two glowing violet eyes inside the innermost ring, star charts etched across every band.

A TELESCOPE GOLEM: a tall one-eyed creature, a long brass telescope tube as its head and neck aimed forward like a cannon with a glowing violet lens for an eye, a wooden tripod as splayed legs, engraved focus rings as collar joints, thin brass arms holding a rolled star chart and a compass, tarnished metal.

A CRYSTAL GOLEM: a jagged angular humanoid grown from tall translucent blue-white crystals, sharp shards jutting from its shoulders and spine, inner light glowing along every axis of its body, a faceted crystal head with two glowing violet eyes deep inside the stone, blocky crystal fists, cracked stone base fused to its feet, refracted highlights.

A FONT GOLEM: a creature carrying a carved pale stone basin as its own hollow chest, filled with liquid starlight that slops over the edge, pinpricks of light drifting up out of it, limbs of pouring luminous starwater held in shape, gold constellation inlay glowing on its stone shoulders, two glowing violet eyes above the basin rim, light spilling down its legs.

A PANE GOLEM: a humanoid built from a standing leaded window, its torso the stained sheet with violet eyes burning where two panes meet, arms of wrought iron came, legs of splintered mullion. Light throws coloured shapes through its chest.

A CLOCHE GOLEM: a hunched humanoid whose head and chest are one enormous fogged bell jar with a dead rose inside, violet eyes lit in the condensation, limbs of thin brass framing. The rose inside turns to watch.
A TROUGH GOLEM: a squat wide humanoid formed from a green glass planter, black water sloshing visibly inside its barrel torso, violet eyes below the waterline, arms of fused glass reeds, stubby legs.
A LANTERN GOLEM: a spindly tall humanoid built around an iron post lantern, its head the four-faced lamp with violet fire relit inside, long thin limbs of iron post, glass moths orbiting it.

A HOARD GOLEM: a lurching humanoid of drowned gold, coins and goblets packed and crusted into limbs, kelp hanging from it like hair, violet eyes in a face of pressed crowns, seawater running out of every seam.
A CORAL GOLEM: a broad humanoid grown from vault coral, fan-coral shoulders spread wide, brain coral for a skull with violet eyes sunk in the folds, fists of blunt stony branch.
A STRONGBOX GOLEM: a heavy stunted humanoid, torso a burst iron strongbox with violet light pouring from the broken lock, thick banded arms, tiny legs, coins rattling inside it as it walks.
AN ANCHOR GOLEM: a tall lean humanoid whose spine and skull are a ship's anchor, chain wrapped around its limbs as muscle, violet eyes at the anchor's crown, dragging a tail of heavy chain.
A PULPIT GOLEM: a stooped humanoid of stretched hide and bone framing, an open hymnal fused into its chest with pages turning, violet eyes above it, long thin arms of bone, reading itself aloud.
A BELL GOLEM: a broad heavy humanoid whose torso and head are one cracked bronze bell, violet light in the split, arms of knotted bell-rope, short thick legs, tolling with every step.

AN ORGAN GOLEM: a tall broad humanoid built from a rank of tarnished organ pipes, pipes of uneven height rising from its shoulders like a crown, violet eyes deep in the pipe-mouths, wheezing air as it moves.
A CENSER GOLEM: a lean humanoid built around a swinging brass censer, its head the pierced smoking lid with violet eyes in the piercings, chains for arms, a constant trail of incense smoke.
A COLUMN GOLEM: a tall broad humanoid built from a sheared fluted column, ash pouring from its joints, violet eyes in a cracked capital head, blocky stone limbs, hugely heavy.
A KILN GOLEM: a squat wide humanoid whose torso is a brick kiln with its iron door hanging open, violet fire relit deep inside, short thick brick limbs, trailing ash.
A BELLOWS GOLEM: a lopsided humanoid built around a great split bellows, the leather lung wheezing on its back, violet eyes above the nozzle, one huge arm and one small, breathing ash.
A CAIRN GOLEM: a lumpen humanoid of stacked black volcanic stones held together by nothing visible, violet light showing between the stones, a petrified hand still caught in its chest.

A THRONE GOLEM: a hulking humanoid built from a carved obsidian throne, the crown-of-thorns seat back rising over its shoulders, violet eyes deep in the empty seat set into its chest, heavy black glass limbs.

A BANNER GOLEM: a tall thin humanoid draped in a heavy black royal banner, the broken pole its spine, violet eyes burning through the unpicked hole where the sigil was, cloth moving as though underwater.
A RELIQUARY GOLEM: a squat humanoid whose torso is a black glass casket with the lid ajar, a gold circlet floating inside, violet eyes above it, short heavy limbs of glass and gilt.
A BRAZIER GOLEM: a tall spindly humanoid built around a black iron brazier, its bowl-head full of relit violet fire, thin crown-worked iron limbs, scattering dead coals.

A CHEST GOLEM: a squat bandy-legged humanoid built from an iron-bound treasure chest, the open lid its hinged jaw lined with lock-teeth, violet eyes burning inside the chest cavity, thick banded arms of oak and iron, stubby clawed feet. Coins and a spilled goblet rattle in its belly as it lurches.

AN UNTHROWN IRON LEVER on a stone plinth: a heavy iron lever with a clearly VISIBLE straight handle angled sharply UPWARD at forty-five degrees toward the viewer's right, its tip well above the plinth — cocked, ready to be thrown. Brass collar at the pivot, bolted to a small carved stone base. The rune etched into the plinth is DARK and unlit, cold. The handle must be present and obvious; overall shape roughly as tall as it is wide.

A THROWN IRON LEVER on a stone plinth: a heavy iron lever with a clearly VISIBLE straight handle angled sharply DOWNWARD at forty-five degrees toward the viewer's right, its tip level with the top of the plinth — thrown, not removed. Brass collar at the pivot, bolted to a small carved stone base. The rune etched into the plinth GLOWS bright amber. The handle must be present and obvious; overall shape roughly as tall as it is wide.

A SHUT IRON PORTCULLIS filling a stone doorway: seven thick vertical iron bars with WIDE OPEN GAPS between them that you can see straight through, hanging from a heavy horizontal stone lintel across the top, two thin horizontal iron ties crossing the bars, sharpened spikes on the bottom end of every bar. Pitted dark iron, rust at the joints. The gaps between the bars are EMPTY — nothing behind them. Roughly square, as wide as it is tall.
assets.extra: CRITICAL: the spaces between the bars must be pure flat white background, completely empty, with nothing drawn in them — no wall, no room, no shading, no darkness. Only the bars, the ties and the lintel are drawn.

assets.prompt: A SINGLE IRON FLOOR SPIKE: one tall narrow tapering iron spike standing straight up, wide at the base and coming to a sharp needle point at the top, like a stake driven upward through a flagstone. Pitted dark iron, a bright honed edge catching the light down one side, rust and old dried blood near the base. Just the one spike, nothing else, no floor, no plate, no socket.
assets.extra: CRITICAL: exactly ONE spike, vertical, centered, point upward, standing alone. Do not draw a floor, a base plate, a row of spikes or a bed of spikes.

assets.prompt: A PENDULUM BLADE hanging from above: a long straight iron shaft descending from the top of the frame, ending in a heavy brass pivot collar, below which hangs a huge curved crescent axe blade like a scythe, its outer edge honed bright silver and razor sharp, the inner body dark pitted iron. The whole thing hangs straight DOWN, vertical, the blade at the bottom.
assets.extra: CRITICAL: the shaft must reach the very TOP edge of the image and the blade must hang at the bottom. Vertical, centered, hanging straight down. No ceiling, no room, no chain — one rigid shaft and one crescent blade.

assets.prompt: A DUNGEON LADDER seen straight on: two heavy vertical wooden stiles bound with iron straps, joined by SIX evenly spaced horizontal wooden rungs with WIDE OPEN GAPS between them that you can see straight through. Worn timber, iron nails, damp and old. Tall and narrow.
assets.extra: CRITICAL: the gaps between the rungs must be pure flat white background, completely empty, nothing drawn in them — no wall, no shadow, no darkness. Only the two stiles and the six rungs are drawn.

assets.prompt: A SHUT IRON TRAPDOOR set into a stone floor, viewed from DIRECTLY ABOVE looking straight down: a square pair of iron-banded double leaves that meet along a seam down the middle, heavy riveted iron straps across each leaf, a recessed ring pull, set in a square stone rebate. Flat top-down plan view, no perspective, no side walls visible.
assets.extra: CRITICAL: a strict top-down bird's eye view of a flat square panel in the floor. Square, filling the frame. No perspective, no walls, no room, no side of anything.

assets.prompt: A STONE PRESSURE PLATE set into a dungeon floor, viewed from DIRECTLY ABOVE looking straight down: one thick square slab of grey stone banded with dark iron along its four edges, sitting inside a square rebate cut into the flagstones with a narrow black gap all the way around it, and a heavy round iron boss in the middle of the slab worn smooth and bright by boots. Chipped stone, pitted iron, old grime down in the gap. Flat top-down plan view, no perspective, no side walls visible.
assets.extra: CRITICAL: a strict top-down bird's eye view of one flat square slab in the floor. Square, filling the frame, with the black gap visible on all four sides. No perspective, no walls, no room, no side of anything, no lever, no chain, no keyhole, no spikes.

assets.prompt: LOW GREEN GRASS: a small sparse tuft of ankle-height grass. BRIGHT GREEN and MOSS GREEN blades, vivid and alive, clearly green. Thin blades splayed LOW and WIDE and drooping outward, no upright stems, no woody parts, no thorns, no flowers, no dirt, no rock. Just a low spray of green grass blades. WIDER THAN IT IS TALL, flat and unremarkable.

A CLUSTER OF THORN SPIKES: sparse, tall, spear-straight woody stalks driven up out of the stone at angles, each one a rigid yellow spine tipped with a hard point, very few leaves. Open and see-through between the stalks, more a bed of spikes than a bush. Ochre and pale gold, hard and dry. Reads as a trap you would not step into. Knee-to-waist high, standing on bare dungeon stone. Dark shadowed gaps deep inside it so it reads as a volume and not a flat panel. NOT woven, NOT a basket, NOT a lattice, NOT a fence, no repeating pattern, no border.

assets.$comment: THE ROSTER. One portrait per page element — see src/game/wizards.ts. Kind `portrait` is the only framing in the pipeline that crops its subject, because a full body at thumbnail size is a portrait with no face in it. Each prompt carries the character's REASON, not just their element: Ash is hate, Kela is a hunter, Zel is greed, Vane is delight, Vess is dying, Yew is late.

assets.prompt: ASH THE FIREWIZARD: a HARD, MEAN, BRUTAL-LOOKING man in his late twenties, FULL OF HATE. UGLY THICK BURN SCARS covering the whole left side of his face, jaw and neck — raw, ropey, puckered scar tissue, one eyebrow burned away. Crooked broken nose. SNARLING, teeth slightly bared, brows drawn down hard, eyes narrowed to furious slits. WEATHERED SUN-DAMAGED TAN SKIN, stubble, dirt and soot ground into his face. Hair hacked short and uneven, singed. He wears a DEEP CRIMSON mantle over blackened battered leather with a BRASS buckle. Harsh ember-orange light on the scarred side, COOL TEAL rim light behind. He looks like a violent man who has lost everything. ABSOLUTELY NOT handsome, NOT pretty, NOT smooth-skinned, NOT a vampire, NOT elegant, no pale flawless skin.

KELA THE WINTERMAIDEN: a demon hunter in her thirties, face full of CONTAINED FURY — not calm, not neutral, not blank. Jaw clenched hard, muscle tight in her cheek, brows drawn down and inward, pale grey eyes narrowed and locked on something with absolute intent, mouth pressed into a thin flat line. The look of a woman who has decided. A thin scar across the bridge of her nose. White-blonde hair pulled back hard, frost on the ends. RUDDY WIND-BURNT SKIN, red at the nose and cheekbones. She wears a DEEP INDIGO BLUE coat with OXBLOOD RED straps and a GREEN GLASS amulet. Pale blue frost light from the left, WARM AMBER lamplight on her right cheek. Intense and readable. NOT expressionless, NOT serene, NOT vacant, NOT a blank stare.

ZEL THE STORMWRIGHT: a young woman with a SULTRY, HUNGRY, KNOWING expression — chin tilted down, looking UP at the viewer through her lashes, HALF-LIDDED heavy eyes, one eyebrow raised, a slow crooked SMIRK at one corner of her mouth. Covetous and confident, like someone appraising something she has already decided to take. CALM and composed, NOT startled. Sleek FIERY COPPER-ORANGE hair falling loose over one eye, NOT standing on end. A few lazy ELECTRIC YELLOW-WHITE sparks drifting from her fingertips near her jaw, throwing warm yellow light up onto her face. Warm fair freckled skin, bright well-lit face. She wears a COBALT BLUE coat open low with GOLD buttons. YELLOW, GOLD and BLUE, vivid and saturated. NOT shocked, NOT electrocuted, NOT wide-eyed, NOT manic, NOT hair standing up, NOT grinning with teeth.

VANE THE WINDWALKER: a cheerful weather-tanned young man mid-laugh, blonde hair and a long TEAL scarf blown sideways out of frame by wind. Bright BLUE eyes, warm sun-browned skin. He wears a SAND-CREAM travelling shirt with a BURNT ORANGE sash. Warm pale daylight from the upper left, cool blue shadow. The only person here having a good time. Full colour, not a single-hue image.

VESS THE PLAGUEBOUND: a gaunt man with sunken cheeks, visibly dying and entirely calm about it. His skin has a GREY-GREEN pallor with BLACK creeping veins up his throat. He wears a rich DEEP TEAL physician's coat with a BRIGHT SAFFRON YELLOW silk scarf knotted at the throat and BRASS buckles — strongly coloured clothing against his grey skin. Strong WARM AMBER lantern light on the right of his face, COOL TEAL shadow on the left. TEAL AND GOLD complementary colour scheme, vivid and saturated, definitely NOT a grey or monochrome image.

YEW THE GREENWARDEN: a girl of about fourteen with a FIERCE, DEFIANT, STUBBORN expression — chin lifted and jutting forward, brows drawn down and together in a hard scowl, wide bright hazel eyes BLAZING with determination and a flicker of fear underneath, mouth pressed into a tight stubborn line. The face of a child nobody would listen to who came down anyway. Freckles across her nose, a smudge of dirt on one cheek, a small cut on her eyebrow. Messy sun-bleached light brown hair full of leaves, VIVID EMERALD GREEN moss, tiny WHITE flowers and SCARLET RED berries tangled in it, one green shoot curling behind her ear. Warm freckled sun-tanned skin, flushed cheeks. WARM OCHRE-GOLD smock, DEEP BLUE scarf. Bright dappled golden-green light from the upper right, cool blue shadow. Vivid and saturated. NOT calm, NOT serene, NOT blank, NOT expressionless, NOT smiling politely, NOT an adult, NOT an old man.
